title: Answer: no account of space, which is one of the scales a causal model is coarse-grained along

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on what space is. Space is one of the axes along which a system's causal structure is described: the micro causal model is its most fine-grained representation in space and time, and a spatial macroscale groups micro elements or states into fewer macro ones. Whether a coarser spatial scale has more causal power than the micro is a question about each system.
statements.scope: the 2016 paper When the map is better than the territory, which works through spatial mappings

sources.quote: The microscopic causal model of such a system is its most fine-grained representation in space and time
As they are similar mathematically, here we only examine spatial mappings
